title: Taming Rectified Flow for Inversion and Editing
reviewed_version: PMLR volume 267 published original; retrieved exact supplied PDF URL
summary: Central fixed-probe order argument fails; release midpoint counterevidence and empirical limitations are recorded.

problems.title: Fixed derivative probe does not yield claimed cubic local error
problems.evidence: For v=t^2 exact defect delta*h^2/2-h^3/3; fixed delta=.01 retains quadratic local term. Exact Gaussian RF field independently confirms first-order global asymptotics.
problems.counterevidence: Released FLUX/Hunyuan code uses delta=h/2, reducing exactly to midpoint and restoring second order; no historical failure inference.
problems.impact: Core error-order justification invalid for stated practical step specification.
problems.repair_scope: State signed delta=O(h), reconcile manuscript/code and identify historical configuration.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read original physical p4 Section3.2 Eqs3-9 and explicit delta=.01 experimental prescription, p13 Algorithm1; read FLUX sampling118-134 and Hunyuan scheduler323-326/389-394 with pipeline1038-1070. Source/code identity checked, not author execution.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: The manuscript claims cubic local truncation error for the practical finite-difference replacement. Smooth vector fields and signed integration increments are admissible; Algorithm1 does not impose delta_i proportional to h_i. Exact Taylor integration itself is sound.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Euler directional probing gives total derivative plus O(delta), hence step defect O(h^3)+O(h^2 delta). For v=t^2, exact integration gives defect delta h^2/2-h^3/3. Stronger fresh population-RF check: independent standard Gaussian endpoints yield a(t)=(2t-1)/[t^2+(1-t)^2], x(t)=sqrt(t^2+(1-t)^2). At t0,x1 the exact total velocity derivative is1, but the Euler probe difference is exactly1/[delta^2+(1-delta)^2]; the resulting nonzero h^2 defect coefficient below directly proves failure inside a valid RF family without relying on the previous numerical convergence plot.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Both acquired implementations use delta=h/2 and algebraically reduce to x+h*k2, explicit midpoint. This is a legitimate second-order repair under standard smoothness/stability assumptions. Gaussian-RF special third-order cancellation does not imply a general higher order. Forward/backward midpoint for xprime=x multiplies by1+h^4/4, consistent with the paper small-step inversion qualification rather than exact discrete reversibility. No historical benchmark failure or priority claim follows.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Major retained because the stated fixed-probe algorithm fails the central claimed local order, although the release supports a valid repaired method. Require delta=O(h), signed in-range probes and paper-matched configuration evidence. Order alone does not guarantee coarse-grid metric gains. The p4 fixed positive probe at t1 can leave the training interval; this is an unresolved boundary behavior, not an established network failure.

problems.title: Cross-backbone baseline does not isolate numerical sampler advantage
problems.evidence: DPM-Solver on Stable Diffusion versus RF-Solver/Heun on FLUX; paired uncertainty not reported.
problems.counterevidence: Same-FLUX RF and Heun comparisons remain relevant.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read original pp6-8 Tables1,2,5 and p13 B.1. Checked release sampler, value replacement lines247-255, and editing entry-point157-164.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: B.1 assigns DPM to Stable Diffusion but RF/Heun/proposed to FLUX, so that comparison changes the vector field and settings. Same-FLUX Heun FID24.40 to23.98 and CLIP31.03 to31.09 remain useful within-backbone observations; their sampling uncertainty cannot be inferred from displayed point estimates. Two stage evaluations give2 calls/step, but NFE does not bound feature-transfer memory/runtime overhead.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Table5 holds feature sharing and NFE fixed; third-order FID23.94 is slightly better than23.98 with equal CLIP31.09, while inversion/editing favor second order. No consistent additional benefit is a fair narrowed reading of the prose. Values are actually injected while current queries/keys remain, supporting the implementation description. Different inversion/target guidance is purposeful for editing and does not isolate pure integration error.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained for cross-backbone causal attribution and stability of small score differences; use common-backbone paired configurations and uncertainty. No rejection of observed whole-system comparisons, no audit of unspecified third derivative construction or historical OpenSora path.

problems.title: Video quality metrics do not independently establish semantic editing success
problems.evidence: Temporal/appearance metrics can be high for unchanged source; custom prompts and sharing-step tuning lack full held-out protocol.
problems.counterevidence: Qualitative figures show successful examples; paper discusses preservation/edit tradeoff.
problems.impact: Aggregate editing-success claim requires direct target-aware evaluation.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read original p7 Tables3-4, p8 sharing-step ablation and p13 B.1-B.2 video metric definitions.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Subject consistency, smoothness, aesthetics and imaging quality measure temporal/appearance properties without testing the target edit. An unchanged coherent source video can satisfy these criteria and fail the edit. Manual prompt refinement and case-dependent step tuning are described; an independent held-out selection protocol is not established by these statements.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Paper explicitly recognizes excessive feature sharing prevents edits and low LPIPS can reward preservation, and provides qualitative successful cases. Baseline hyperparameters are also tuned; this does not demonstrate deliberately asymmetric tuning or fabricated outcomes. Image CLIP results do measure a target-related aspect and are not invalidated by this video-specific limitation.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained for dataset-wide semantic video-edit claims; require target-aware evaluation or blinded judgments and item/tuning protocol. No temporal playback or benchmark reproduction claimed.

limitations: No author programs or checkpoints executed.
No independent benchmark runs, raw images/videos or hidden selection protocol.
Separate OpenReview attachments, external citations and other paper versions not checked.
